description: SHA-256 hash of the compound SMILES (KinDEL identifier)
Compound structure (SMILES)
Building block at position A (row of synthons/reacted_a.csv)
Building block at position B (row of synthons/reacted_b.csv)
Building block at position C (row of synthons/reacted_c.csv)
Sequence count in target selection replicate 1 (distinct encodings)
Sequence count in target selection replicate 2 (distinct encodings)
Sequence count in target selection replicate 3 (distinct encodings)
Sequence count in no-protein (matrix) control replicate 1
Sequence count in no-protein (matrix) control replicate 2
Sequence count in no-protein (matrix) control replicate 3
Sequence count in the pre-selection library (synthesis abundance)
Pooled target count (three replicates)
Pooled control count (three replicates)
Number of target replicates with at least one count (0-3)
Whether the compound's BB-A was drawn at random (unbiased; used to fit the prior)
Mean target count minus mean control count (KinDEL Counts baseline)
Depth-normalised enrichment ratio with pseudocount
Maximum-likelihood rate ratio target/control (null when the control count is 0)
Lower bound of the exact confidence interval of the rate ratio (ranking score)
Upper bound of the exact confidence interval of the rate ratio (null when unbounded)
Normalised z-score of the target fraction against a uniform library (Faver et al. 2019)
Empirical-Bayes shrunken log2 rate ratio (Beta-Binomial prior)
Unique id of a triaged hit: <screen>:<molecule_hash> (a compound can be a hit of several screens)
Target screen the compound is a top hit of (one row per screen and compound)
Rank of the compound in its screen by Poisson lower bound (1 = best)
Triage tier: 1 = replicate and disynthon support, 2 = one of them, 3 = neither, flagged = counter-screen or bead binder
Lower bound of the matrix (bead) control over pre-selection load rate ratio
Other target screens in whose top table the compound also appears (semicolon-separated)
Best-supported disynthon of the compound (AB, AC or BC), scored without the compound itself
Lower bound of the rate ratio of that disynthon's other members
Highest lower bound of the rate ratio over all counter-screens (null if never observed)
Counts in at least two of three target replicates
The compound's best disynthon is enriched without the compound itself
Enriched in a counter-screen (an unrelated protein): likely an artefact
Enriched in the bead (matrix) control over its synthesis load: likely an artefact
Also a top hit of another target screen (reported but not penalised)
Human-readable summary of the triage evidence
